title: First In-Person Week with Luminate in Rochester
body:
The VanaM team just returned from Rochester, New York, after an exciting and productive first in-person week with Luminate Accelerator and NextCorps. It was our team's first time in Rochester, and while the schedule was packed, we had a fantastic time connecting with fellow Cohort 8 startups and the incredible Team Luminate.

We're already looking forward to the upcoming in-person weeks! 🚀
body_ko:
VanaM 팀이 Luminate 액셀러레이터·NextCorps와 함께한 첫 대면 주간을 마치고 뉴욕 로체스터에서 막 돌아왔습니다. 팀에게는 첫 로체스터 방문이었고, 일정은 빡빡했지만 8기 동료 스타트업들과 훌륭한 Luminate 팀을 만나며 값진 시간을 보냈습니다.

다음 대면 주간이 벌써 기다려집니다! 🚀
